description: This file defines the 'ReviewerRating' entity class, which represents reviewer ratings within the OrangeHRM performance module. It includes properties for rating details, relationships to performance review, reviewer, and KPI entities, and accessor methods.

classes.name: ReviewerRating
classes.description: Entity class for reviewer ratings including properties such as rating, comment, and relations to performance review, reviewer, and KPI. Uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the primary key ID of the reviewer rating.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the reviewer rating.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Retrieves additional comments for the rating.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Sets additional comments for the rating.

methods.name: setKpi
methods.description: Associates a KPI with the rating.
